violations.text: Several floor and coving tiles in the kitchen areas were observed to be cracked and chipped and in need of repair/replacement. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026

The following areas of the physical facilities were observed with an accumulation of soil residue, debris, etc... - Ceiling tiles and vents were observed with a buildup of dust - The basement floor was observed with an accumulation of standing water (per the PIC, due to be cleaned after recent air ventilation repair work). The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
